welcome.text: Hello, explorer! I’m Milo. Welcome to Ervin’s little town. What would you like to know?

about.text: Ervin studied computer science at BINUS University. This little town brings together some of the things he has made and learned along the way.

town.text: Think of it as a place to wander! The workshop shows Ervin’s skills. The arcade is southwest of the fountain, and the photo garden is to its east.

hobbies.text: Here are a few things Ervin enjoys!

welcome.text: Hey there! I’m Ivy. Welcome to the workshop. Curious about what Ervin likes to build?

skills.text: Here are some of the tools and technologies he has picked up along the way!

creations.text: There’s a project-management app made with friends, a chat experiment, and a little Pokédex. Look for the display near the plaza!

town.text: The town guide can tell you more about Ervin, and there’s a noticeboard if you’d like to say hello.
